guide.warningTitle: Warning: these are your real saves
guide.warning: The command moves your saves to Documents/Stardew Valley/Saves and leaves a link where the game looks: the game then uses that folder, so don't delete it. Before moving, it creates Documents/Stardew Valley/Backup, which updates about 1 minute after each change and never deletes anything. If something goes wrong, run the command again: it restores from the backup. Saves and backup sit together: deleting the whole Stardew Valley folder deletes both.
guide.untested: This command hasn't been tested on this system yet. Copy your saves somewhere else before running it.

how.local: The site reads your saves right from your PC; nothing is uploaded.

saves.removeHint: Only removes it from the site: your saves stay on your PC.
saves.needsBrowser: This site reads your saves live, which only works in Chrome, Edge, Brave or Opera.

restore.title: Put the folders back to normal
restore.text: Close the game and run this. Your saves go back to where the game keeps them, and the link and the backup updates are removed. The Backup folder stays in Documents/Stardew Valley: delete it only if you want to.
